summary: Tested 3 bug fixes: WhatsApp settings from DB, media upload (GridFS), reviewer_avatar. Backend: 10/11 tests passed. Frontend: WhatsApp button confirmed working from DB. Admin UI not fully testable due to CORS (localhost frontend hitting production backend URL).

critical.issue: Admin-created reviews via POST /api/admin/reviews do NOT include reviewer_avatar field in DB because AdminReviewCreate Pydantic model is missing reviewer_avatar field. User-created reviews (POST /api/reviews) DO have it correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Admin login from localhost test env
integration_issues.issue: CORS error when frontend (localhost:3000) calls production backend URL (code-viewer-76). This is expected in local testing env — production deployment should work fine as both frontend/backend are on same domain.

action_items: Add reviewer_avatar: Optional[str] = '' field to AdminReviewCreate Pydantic model in server.py so admin-created reviews also store/return reviewer_avatar in the DB document
Update admin_create_review handler (line ~1079) to include reviewer_avatar in the saved doc
critical_code_review_comments: AdminReviewCreate model (line 272) is missing reviewer_avatar field — causing admin-created reviews to not have avatar in GET /api/reviews/{product_id} response
MediaUploader component correctly implemented with Browse/URL tabs, file picker, thumbnail previews with remove button, and /api/admin/upload-media integration
WhatsApp number in Header and WhatsAppButton.jsx correctly reads from useSiteSettings() hook — not hardcoded
reviewer_avatar passed correctly in ProductDetailPage.jsx POST /api/reviews payload and displayed with referrerPolicy=no-referrer

success_rate.frontend: WhatsApp button confirmed, Admin panel UI untestable from localhost (CORS)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 test review (TEST_ReviewUser) via admin API during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend mostly working. Key bug: AdminReviewCreate missing reviewer_avatar field. WhatsApp from DB settings works correctly. MediaUploader component added and APIs work (upload + serve). Frontend runs on port 3000 with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL pointing to production domain — causes CORS from localhost test env.
rca_of_issue: reviewer_avatar field missing from AdminReviewCreate model. Fix: add 'reviewer_avatar: Optional[str] = ""' to class AdminReviewCreate(BaseModel) in server.py. The existing ReviewCreate (user reviews) has this field and works correctly.
